Results.ReviewText: The Ironwood 885 is an amazing pellet grill. I’ve been using it for about a month now, anywhere from 3-5 days a week. You have to tinker with the temperatures to find your ideal cooking temps for different ways of cooking. For example 325-375 degrees is ideal for grilling for me, this way you don’t get flare ups and avoid catching your whole grill on fire. My only complaint is the probe, it isn’t as accurate as I thought it would be. That isn’t really a problem as I use a thermapen mk4 for dead on temperature readings. The probe in my opinion is more to have an idea of the internal temp. I definitely see myself purchasing the Timberline 1300 in the near future. These grills are amazing and bring your cooking game to a WHOLE new level, not to mention the awesome Traeger app that let’s you control your grill anywhere once connected to WiFi. Highly Recommend

Results.ReviewText: Holds a very consistent temperature, but the gap between the grease pan and the edge of the grill grate makes it easily prone to grease fires which ruin meals and are very dangerous. A wider grease pan, probably just elevate a bit more from its current position, would eliminate that end still allow for the airflow needed to create the polling smoke which allows for temperature consistency and even smoke distribution throughout the grill. Also, a larger grease pan should have a steeper pitch on it to ensure all grease flows to the trap. Liners would be more effective if they had a bit of a foldable wing to ensure the actual pan itself is completely covered, eliminating the need for extra foil around the edges. Great flavor, but a real design flaw in my opinion that could be easily fixed.
Results.Title: Great grill, but grease pan needs redesign.
